children: DAMAC Properties is targeting the handover of more than 8,800 residential units across Dubai by the end of 2026.
These units are located in DAMAC Lagoons, DAMAC Hills, DAMAC Hills 2, Chic Tower and Elegance Tower, the developer said in a statement.

"With more than 10 billion UAE dirhams worth of construction contracts awarded in the first half of 2026, we are strengthening our delivery platform and maintaining momentum across our portfolio to meet the commitments made to our customers,” said Amira Sajwani, Managing Director, DAMAC Properties.
“Having delivered more than 50,000 homes at scale, the next 55,000+ demand rigorous control at every stage,” said Mohammad Tahaineh, Chief Project Officer, DAMAC Properties.
He added that the company has anticipated and mitigated risks before they could affect delivery schedules.
“This operational resilience has kept construction progressing throughout 2026, despite significant geopolitical pressures on global supply chains.”
Nearly 6,300 homes will be handed over at DAMAC Lagoons, followed by more than 1,500 villas in DAMAC Hills 2.
DAMAC has awarded more than 10 billion UAE dirhams ($2.72 billion) in construction contracts in the first half of 2026.
These contracts will establish the base for the next phase of deliveries in 2027 and beyond, the statement said.

title: DAMAC gears up to deliver nearly 9,000 units in Dubai by 2026-end
